verdict.rationale: Firebase ships an official CLI (firebase-tools) that deploys code and assets, interacts with database data, and imports/exports Auth users. Its official MCP server lets an agent create and manage projects, manage Auth users, and work with Firestore data. Security Rules exist, but the evidence never says the CLI deploys rules, configures auth providers, or defines a schema, and it does not document headless or non-interactive scripted operation. missing for 10: explicit CLI deployment of security rules/policies, CLI configuration of auth providers (beyond user import/export), schema or index provisioning from the CLI, documented non-interactive/CI scripting mode, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent-driven backend setup.
